description: Überschwemmungsgebiete der Remte in der Stadt Hameln is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Hazardous areas for statistically expected flood events of the Remte every 100 years or for extremely rare flood events of the Remte. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Remte floodplains in the city of Hameln" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Stadt Hameln. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
